properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Ideas 7 and 8 from the qs project agent, 2026-09-04.

WHAT THEY ASKED FOR, and the detail that makes it a design question rather than a formatting one: "A PLAIN-LANGUAGE WALKTHROUGH OF GAPS AND DEFECTS. The user asked for exactly that and I PRODUCED IT MANUALLY; the data is already there, a rendering that speaks the owner's domain (REQUIREMENT, CHECK, PART) instead of EDGE NAMES would be a direct win."

And beside it: "A DECISIONS AWAITING THE OWNER view SCOPED TO A SESSION. I kept that list BY HAND in the final report each time. `loop_status` counts assigned decisions but NOT the proposed exploratory ones the user has been asked about in conversation."

BOTH ARE THE SAME COMPLAINT FROM DIFFERENT ENDS: the design holds the answer, the tool returns it in the graph's vocabulary, and the agent hand-translates it for the human every single time. That translation is unpaid work done identically in every session, and it is exactly the kind of thing that is done well once and badly thereafter.

WHAT ALREADY EXISTS AND WHY IT DID NOT SERVE. `gap_to_prompt` is the handshake that turns a gap into a question in the user's words — so half of this is BUILT. It is per-gap and on the ask path; what they wanted was a WHOLE-LIST reading on the report path. `where-am-i` renders the design in plain language and its own instructions were changed on 2026-08-29 to lead with the delivery line. Neither covers "walk me through what is open and why it matters", which is what the user actually asked for.

DIRECTIONS, none chosen:
1. A SKILL. Cheapest; it is a rendering, not a computation, and skills are served so it cannot go stale. The where-am-i skill is the obvious home. Counter: they HAD the skills and still wrote it by hand, so the instruction leg alone did not carry it.
2. A `gaps_to_prompts`-STYLE BULK HANDSHAKE OVER THE WHOLE OPEN LIST, reusing the mechanism that already phrases one gap in the user's words. The machinery exists and is proven; this is a scope change rather than a new idea.
3. A SESSION-SCOPED "AWAITING YOU" ROLLUP on loop_status, covering proposed exploratory decisions the user has actually been asked about. Counter, and it is sharp: the graph CANNOT KNOW what was asked in conversation. `AUTHORED_BY role=approver` is the only durable record of an ask, and an exploratory decision raised in chat carries no such edge. So this needs the ask to be RECORDED at the moment it is made, which is a change to the brainstorm path, not to loop_status.

THE VOCABULARY QUESTION UNDERNEATH, which is the reason this is worth recording rather than just building: whose words? They say "the owner's domain (requirement, check, part)". But `user-se-background-viewpoint-doctrine` holds that SE jargon is KEPT for this user and only reflow2-internal jargon is dropped, and the qs owner is a systems engineer. So "plain language" is not one target - it is a per-contributor lens, and reflow2 already serves skills with a lens attached. That may be the mechanism rather than a new renderer.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the served lens already carries enough to do this. It named the contributor well enough for qs to notice; nobody has checked whether it carries the vocabulary preference too, or whether a renderer could read it.
properties.name: OPEN — a first-time user asked for the gaps in plain language and the agent wrote it by hand. Should reflow2 render the owner's view, and whose vocabulary is it in?
properties.no_relation_note: Searched the open-list and reporting neighbourhood. The nearest nodes are the aggregation defect recorded today (one missing edge, three findings) and the instruction-surface finding about reports being reachable but unread. Neither is honestly related: this asks what LANGUAGE a rendering should use and who it is for, while those ask how many rows a cause produces and whether a report is reachable at all. Linking them would put a false neighbour in front of anyone searching either.
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill; recorded as an idea, nothing promoted. Kept as one node rather than two because their idea 7 and idea 8 are the same complaint at different scopes and a fix to the rendering path would plausibly serve both.
